constraints: The toggle must be part of the chatbot UI.
The selected theme preference must persist across sessions.
intent.goal: Add a dark mode toggle to the chatbot UI so users can switch between light and dark themes with their preference persisted across sessions.
success_criteria: Users can switch the chatbot UI between light and dark themes.
The chatbot UI restores the user's previously selected theme in a later session.

name: Add a dark mode toggle to the chatbot UI so users can switch between light and dark themes with their preference persisted across sessions.
